title: Lemon-Basil Fettuccine with Seared Tempeh & Broccoli

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until almost done, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil and spices.
Slice tempeh crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the garlic-oil, stir to coat, and set aside to marinate.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.

When the pasta is almost done, add broccoli to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta reaches desired firmness and broccoli is tender, 2-3 minutes more. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ⅓-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add tempeh in a single layer; cook, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes.
While the tempeh is cooking, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the tempeh is done, juice lemon into the skillet.

Add drained pasta, broccoli, reserved pasta cooking water, and half of the basil to the skillet. Toss to combine and continue to cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!
